events.description: Islamic State (ISKP) attack on Crocus City Hall theatre in Moscow by four Tajik gunmen; 140+ killed, hundreds wounded; IS claimed with video; Russia detained four Tajiks
Pakistani airstrikes in Paktika and Khost targeting TTP; Afghan Taliban respond with artillery/mortar fire into Pakistan and threats of war
AQAP emir Khalid Batarfi reported dead of illness; confirmed by AQ central
Rumoured death of Saif al-Adel's son (AQAP leader) in a fire; photo circulated; unconfirmed
Shabaab retakes most areas in Mudug lost during the 2022-23 Somali offensive; attacks AU/SNA bases after handovers
UN Monitoring Team reports Al-Karrar office in Puntland funding ISKP ~$25,000/month in cryptocurrency
40-50 militant groups joined TTP over the past year; Hafiz Gul Bahadur group converging with TTP
~1,000 Pakistani civilians and soldiers killed in fighting with TTP last year
Height of TTP insurgency: 100,000+ Pakistani casualties, suicide attacks on GHQ Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Karachi; TTP reached Buner, 60 miles from Islamabad
Mumbai attacks; a Pakistani corps commander afterwards called the TTP 'brothers' and urged joint fight against India
Taliban–Iran border clashes over water dispute, resolved
Long War Journal banned in Pakistan for reporting Taliban–Pakistani state links

key_claims: The Islamic State 'never left'; ISKP's Moscow attack follows years of anti-Russia propaganda and Russia's wars against jihadists in Chechnya, Syria, Mali, Burkina Faso and Mozambique.
Conspiracy theories that Russia or Ukraine staged the Crocus attack rob the Islamic State of agency; IS claimed it with video.
Shabaab is reversing Somalia's 2022-23 offensive; if AU forces leave the Somali government may survive only months to a year or two.
US-trained CT forces (Danab) misused in COIN mirror the Afghan commandos' fate.
Reported deaths of AQAP emir Batarfi (illness) and Saif al-Adel's son (fire) within weeks are suspicious; jihadists have faked deaths before (Abdul Haq al-Turkistani, Mullah Omar's concealed death).
Al-Qaeda has not acknowledged Zawahiri's death for two years to spare the Taliban embarrassment and avoid highlighting Saif al-Adel's presence in Iran.

Pakistan's March 2024 airstrikes on TTP in Paktika/Khost and Taliban retaliation will blow over; Pakistan absorbed 100,000+ casualties 2007-2015 and still backs the Taliban for strategic depth against India.
TTP is on the upswing: 40-50 groups joined in the past year and Hafiz Gul Bahadur's group is effectively merged with it.

Al-Qaeda's Afghan infrastructure (camps in 10 of 34 provinces) exists only because the Pakistani state supports the Afghan Taliban; elements of the Pakistani military are ideologically aligned with the jihadists.
